nRFCab.comment: tRFCab 270 ns = 16 Gb's 180 ns x1.5 per density doubling (as from GDDR6 8 Gb to GDDR7 16 Gb), rounded up at 571 ps; JESD239D leaves it to vendors

nRFCpb.comment: tRFCpb 60 ns, as for 16 Gb, rounded up at 571 ps

nRFMab.comment: Equal to nRFCab, Ramulator 2.1's own rule (gddr7.py:156-158); refresh management inactive

nRFMpb.comment: Equal to nRFCpb, Ramulator 2.1's own rule (gddr7.py:156-158); refresh management inactive

nRCD_AB.source: the host value of the per-bank command pair

nRCDW_AB.source: the host value of the per-bank command pair

nRAS_AB.source: the host value of the per-bank command pair

nRP_AB.source: the host value of the per-bank command pair

nRRD_AB.source: the host value of the per-bank command pair; the all-bank ACT does not count against tFAW

nCCD_AB.source: an AB column is spaced as an SB one: same-bank read gap

nCCDW_AB.source: an AB column is spaced as an SB one: same-bank write gap

nAB2PRE_RD.source: the host value of the per-bank command pair

nAB2PRE_WR.source: the host value of the per-bank command pair

nCL_GB.source: non-bank commands carry host data: the host latency and tCCD_S

nCL_REG.source: non-bank commands carry host data: the host latency and tCCD_S

nCWL_GB.source: non-bank commands carry host data: the host latency and tCCD_S

nCWL_REG.source: non-bank commands carry host data: the host latency and tCCD_S

nCCD_NB.source: non-bank commands carry host data: the host latency and tCCD_S

nEX_AB_RD.source: a read is done when its data leave the sense amplifiers (tRTP), as nAB2PRE_RD

nEX_AB_WR.source: a write is done when its data are in the sense amplifiers, without write recovery

nSB_RD_DONE.source: a read is done when its data leave the sense amplifiers (tRTP), as an AB read

nSB_WR_DONE.source: a write is done when its data are in the sense amplifiers
